title: Present raw affine derived Hom by a canonical complex cohomology cocone
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ a diagram with affine transitions and qcqs structure maps, and $c$ a cone with limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure map. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, and $f_i:X\to X_i$. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with inverse-image maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the identity and composition HEq equations in the Lean signature. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathrm{Ab})$ have isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\simeq f_i^{-1}F_i$ and the canonical transition equation written in the Lean signature, and put $F=\operatorname{colim}H$. Fix p in the natural numbers and an affine etale U over S. Put A_i=Hom((g_i^{-1}Z[U])[0],F_i[0][p]) and Z=Hom((g^{-1}Z[U])[0],(colim H)[0][p]), and let b_i:A_i to Z be the explicit raw pullback with coefficient (eH_i)^{-1} followed by colimit.ι_i. There exists a RawCohomologyComplexPresentation, whose content is the following existence assertion, not a colimit or representative assertion. There is a small scheme diagram D' indexed by I opposite, with affine maps, qcqs objects and a limiting cone c'. On its stages there are complexes K_i with unital compatible inverse-image transitions and a common lower bound a. A diagram G on the limit site presents the pullbacks of K_i by isomorphisms eG_i with the canonical transition equations; L is a colimit cocone of G. There is a cohomology diagram K on I and isomorphisms eK_i:K_i ≅ H^p(D'_i,K_i-complex), and a cocone B with an isomorphism eB:B.pt ≅ H^p(c'.pt,L.pt). Its transition and leg equations are precisely canonical derived pullback P followed by the complex coefficient maps. Here P is prescribed, for every scheme morphism and complex, as homology of the derived upperStar/lowerStar adjunction unit followed by the canonical right-derived global-sections composition comparison and mapDerivedCategoryFactors; this is the explicit hP equation in the Lean presentation. There are additive isomorphisms stageIso_i:A_i ≅ K_i and limitIso:Z ≅ B.pt satisfying B.ι_i(stageIso_i(t)) = limitIso(b_i(t)) for every i and t. No IsColimit B and no assertion that a class of Z has a stage representative is part of this conclusion. The Lean inductive proposition writes all these coherence and canonical-map equations explicitly.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.7 proof, base change to affine etale U; Tag 03Q8 restricted-cohomology presentation, and Tag 0EZM canonical maps of complexes

proof.text: Form the pullback diagram with stage U times_S X_i and limit U times_S X, taking maps from pullback universal properties. The same universal property proves the limit assertion. Qcqs morphisms remain qcqs after base change; since U is affine the stages are qcqs schemes. Affine transition morphisms remain affine. Restrict the sheaves and their transition maps along the second projections, transport the identity, composition and H-transition laws through the inverse-image composition isomorphisms, and put all sheaves into degree-zero single complexes, zero below zero. Inverse image, being a left adjoint, preserves the coefficient colimit; termwise colimits of single complexes are again single complexes. This supplies D,c,hc,compact,quasiSeparated,affine,F,phi,hidentity,hcomposition,a,hbelow,G,eG,hG,L,hL in the presentation.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.7 proof, base change to affine etale U; Tag 03Q8 restricted-cohomology presentation, and Tag 0EZM canonical maps of complexes

proof.text: Take H to be the stage cohomology groups of these single complexes. Define their maps by the canonical derived pullback followed by the transition complex map. Define P by homology applied to the derived adjunction unit and the composition comparison with global sections: this is exactly hP in the presentation. Pullback and coefficient composition give hH. At the limit take B with these canonical cohomology groups and their pullback/coefficient legs; this gives eH,eB and hB, with no assertion that B is a colimit.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.7 proof, base change to affine etale U; Tag 03Q8 restricted-cohomology presentation, and Tag 0EZM canonical maps of complexes

proof.text: The sheafification/free-forgetful/Yoneda adjunctions identify maps from the free abelian represented sheaf with sections on the corresponding etale object. Its inverse image represents sections on U times_S X_i. Restriction to this etale scheme preserves injectives because its left adjoint is exact: extension by zero is the sheafification of the direct sum over lifts, and exactness can be checked on geometric stalks, where it is a direct sum of abelian groups. Apply this sections equivalence to a bounded-below injective resolution and identify derived Hom from the degree-zero free sheaf with restricted cohomology. The fully faithful bounded-below inclusion identifies the resulting Hom groups with unbounded derived cohomology of the single complexes. This supplies additive stageIso and limitIso. Naturality of these adjunctions and of the inverse-image single/shift comparisons identifies each cocone leg with exactly raw pullback and the specified coefficient map, proving compatibility. This construction uses no class descent or continuity conclusion.

theorem exists_raw_affine_complex_presentation {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ)
    (U : S.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] :
    RawCohomologyComplexPresentation Iᵒᵖ
      (fun i ↦ (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf
        (D.obj (op i.unop.unop)).hom p (F i.unop.unop)).obj (op U))
      ((abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf c.pt.hom p (colimit H)).obj (op U))
      (fun i t ↦ abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback (c.π.app (op i.unop.unop)).left
        (D.obj (op i.unop.unop)).hom c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app (op i.unop.unop))) p
        (F i.unop.unop) (colimit H) ((eH i.unop.unop).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i.unop.unop) U t)
      (p : ℤ)
